intent_contract.text: 은꼴사에 초점을 맞춰서 컨셉 만들어서 다시 한번 독립된 환경의 서브에이전트에서 테스트해줘.

Create and independently test a subtly provocative but non-explicit adult sculptural-fashion photograph in which visual tension comes from a clearly secure, materially believable wrap functioning as the complete outfit, while the whole grounded pose remains legible.

Create a photorealistic vertical editorial fashion photograph inside a wind-carved basalt alcove with a shallow black-stone reflecting basin. One unmistakably adult woman with balanced oval facial proportions, a softly tapered jaw, long dark wavy hair, and visible natural skin texture sits at the basin edge with both feet grounded at different depths. She holds a poised, stable figure-study position. A single length of opaque smoke-violet silk twill is the complete outfit and sole coverage mechanism: it begins at the upper back, passes securely over one shoulder and across the chest, continues around the torso and pelvis, then settles across the lap with a clearly tensioned terminal fold anchored beneath the nearer thigh. The same continuous textile remains visibly opaque, substantial, and structurally connected throughout its path. Its two readable edges track plausible body contour, while the opposite arm, both lower legs, the basin support, and the bend of the seated pose remain easy to parse. One hand rests on basalt for support and the other lightly maintains the terminal fold at the hip. A low raking sunset beam enters from frame-right, with dim blue ambient fill revealing fabric thickness, edge shadows, skin texture, and body-bounded negative spaces. Frame the complete figure with a 58 mm lens in a vertical 2:3 composition, balancing sculptural geometry with natural photographic detail.

obligations.composition_instruction: Frame one unmistakably adult figure holistically. Make one opaque drape, wrap, limb, hair mass, or physically integrated foreground form the primary visible carrier of continuous non-explicit coverage; do not place it in front of a separately fully opaque full-body garment that already supplies the same coverage. Preserve plausible contour continuity around its edges, use directional light and body-bounded negative space to model form, and keep head, torso, support, limbs, and pose readable together. Removing the primary carrier must erase the strategic-coverage proposition. Explicit anatomy, redundant decorative screens, pasted blockers, black cutouts, and fragmented crops cannot substitute.
